name: SoftBridge Texts
description: Modern, secure SMS management app built with Flutter and Native Android integration.
long_description: SoftBridge Texts is a modern, feature-rich, and secure SMS management application built with Flutter and Native Android integration. Designed for speed and cleanliness, it provides a superior alternative to default messaging apps with advanced organization and security features.

name: CommitAds
long_description: CommitAds connects advertisers with developers and empowers open-source maintainers to earn from their work. A single platform for growth and sustainability.

name: HTML Editor PRO - with AI
description: Explore endless possibilities of Web Development in Android with HTML Editor Pro.
long_description: Take your mobile development to the next level with HTML Editor PRO. This professional-grade laboratory tool features an integrated AI assistant, real-time preview, and full support for modern web standards. Whether you're debugging on the go or building complex prototypes, our editor provides a high-performance environment optimized for the Android filesystem. It includes advanced syntax highlighting, auto-completion, and direct integration with GitHub, making it the definitive choice for professional web developers working in mobile contexts.

name: Karbon Sites
description: Go beyond static snippets. Generate, refine, and deploy entire web projects with AI in a powerful and intuitive editor.
long_description: Karbon Sites is the next evolution in web project management. Engineered for rapid prototyping and deployment, it allows you to generate entire project architectures from a single prompt. Our cloud-based laboratory environment handles the heavy lifting of environment configuration, letting you focus on refining your vision. With Karbon, moving from a conceptual laboratory experiment to a live production site takes minutes, not days. It features advanced AI interpolation, modular component injection, and one-click global deployment.

name: SoftBridge Authenticator
description: Powerful 2FA tool with Cloud Sync and Smart Organization.
long_description: Protect your digital life with SoftBridge Authenticator, part of the SoftBridge 365 ecosystem. A powerful 2FA tool with cloud sync, smart organization, and built-in security features like privacy screen and secure export/import.

name: AiDroid
description: Premium AI chat experience built with Flutter and modular clean architecture.
long_description: AiDroid is a professional-grade mobile laboratory for artificial intelligence, engineered with Flutter and Dart. It features a highly decoupled modular architecture, responsive UI, and seamless real-time integration with state-of-the-art AI models. Designed for developers and AI enthusiasts who value high-performance software engineering and scalable state management.
